question: How much does a mobile application cost?
answer:
The available sources do not specify the cost of a mobile application ([Netixsol Homepage](https://www.netixsol.com/), [Product Engineering](https://www.netixsol.com/product-engineering), [Blockchain and DeFi Development](https://www.netixsol.com/blockchain-development), [Netixsol UAE](https://www.netixsol.com/uae)). 

If you would like to discuss a mobile application or product engineering project, please share a bit about your idea or requirements, and we can help scope it out.
